test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Manjusree Chatterjee was awarded the honour of Padma Shri in 2019 for which of the following styles of dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manjusree Chatterjee**

 
 
• **Shrimati Manjushree Chatterjee**, who was born in **Calcutta on May 14, 1941**, started learning** Kathak dance under Nalin Kumar Ganguly**.
 
• Later, after receiving training in the **art from Guru Shambhu**, she performed at a **number of national festivals and led workshops and lecture demonstrations** both in India and overseas.
 
• She continues to mentor aspiring Kathak dancers at her Kala Vihar dance studio in Kolkata.
 
• Shrimati Manjushree Chatterjee has received the Sahitya Kala Parishad Samman, the Rashtriya Ekta Samman from the Rajiv Gandhi Foundation, as well as the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (2011) for her contributions to dance.
 
• She was awarded the honour of Padma Shri in 2019 for Kathak.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak**

 
 
• One of the **eight primary styles of Indian classical dance is kathak**.
 
• It is** Uttar Pradesh's** traditional style of dance.
 
• The Vedic** Sanskrit words Katha, which means "story," and Kathakar, which means "the one who tells a story" or "to do with stories," are the roots of the word Kathak**.
 
• Kathak dancers **use intricate footwork, flexible body movements, and, most importantly, expressive facial expressions to convey a variety of stories**.
 
• The** three different styles of Kathak, or "gharanas,"** are named after the places where the Kathak dance tradition originated: **Jaipur, Banaras, and Lucknow**. 
 
• Th**e Banaras and Lucknow gharanas** emphasise **expressive facial expressions and delicate hand gestures**, whereas the **Jaipur Gharana** places more emphasis on **foot movements**
